body.p: Palna. There lived three brothers Palna. The old one was a selkup strongman. The eldest brother is a strong man. The middle brother catches reindeer in the summer. The youngest brother rushes on the tops of wild rosemary. They lived so. The eldest brother Palna had [OSV:] "kÉrnÊ¼a po" - "a wild rosemary".[OSV:] "kÉt" - "a wizard".shamanic wisdom. He knew where everything would come from. He was a singing old shaman. He lived and forged iron himself. He forged iron just like that, just out of stones. The youngest brother lives on the opposite side of the tent entrance. He sticks the pike there [with the point] upwards. They bound a beam from the granary above the fire. And the three brothers Palna had agreed with each other earlier. All of a sudden the eldest brother hits [a Nenets] with the knife. [The others] also hit like this. He has hardly hit him for the second time [as the other one] (calmly?) caught his pike in the middle. He broke his leg.
